name: mood-music-discovery
description: Search Nova Sounds' released catalogue by description, mood, instruments and sound, and find tracks to listen to on Spotify.

interface.shortDescription: Find Nova music for any mood
interface.longDescription:
Mood Music Discovery searches the released catalogue of Nova Sounds, a Stockholm music label, for music that fits a scene, a mood or an activity. Describe what you need in your own words, such as "instrumental ambient music for a sad cinematic scene with rain", and narrow it down by vocals, mood, instruments, use, energy or tempo. You can look up a track by its ISRC, find tracks that sound similar to one you like, and get a proposed playlist of tracks with Spotify links and preview pages to listen to.

It is made for anyone looking for music that fits a moment, a mood or an activity.

Limitations: results cover only Nova Sounds' released tracks that have been analysed, not all music. It cannot play music itself and creates nothing on Spotify. No account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Find instrumental ambient music for a sad cinematic scene with rain
Make a 15-track playlist of calm instrumental music for focus
Find upbeat tracks without vocals for a product launch video

positive.description: Free-text search for music that fits a scene.
positive.prompt: Find instrumental ambient music for a sad cinematic scene with rain.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tracks with the description (and an instrumental vocal filter if the model adds one). Returns a list of released Nova Sounds tracks with title, artists, a short description, a Spotify link where available and a preview link. No invented tracks or links.

positive.prompt: Make me a 15-track playlist of calm instrumental music for focusing.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls build_playlist with length 15. Returns up to 15 released Nova Sounds tracks, each with a Spotify link, plus a proposed playlist title and description. Nothing is created on Spotify.

positive.description: Look up one track by ISRC.
positive.prompt: Tell me about the Nova Sounds track with ISRC SE7DX2602586.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_track with SE7DX2602586. Returns that track's title, artists, release date, description, moods, instruments, tempo and Spotify link.

positive.description: Find tracks that sound like a given track.
positive.prompt: Find tracks from Nova Sounds that sound similar to SE7DX2602586.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls similar_tracks with SE7DX2602586 (audio similarity by default). Returns other released Nova Sounds tracks ranked by similarity, without the source track itself.

positive.description: Filtered search by tempo and vocals.
positive.prompt: Find upbeat instrumental tracks around 120 BPM from Nova Sounds.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tracks with an upbeat description, an instrumental vocal filter and a BPM range around 120. Returns released Nova Sounds tracks within that tempo range, each with a Spotify link where available and a preview link. No invented tracks.

negative.description: Songwriting request. The app searches existing tracks and cannot write lyrics, so no tool should be called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Write lyrics for a song about rain in Stockholm.

negative.description: Playback of a well-known song by another artist. The app cannot play music and only covers Nova Sounds' catalogue, so no tool should be called.
General music charts question outside Nova Sounds' catalogue, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What are the top songs on the Billboard Hot 100 this week?

review.commerce_description: No commerce of any kind. The app searches Nova Sounds' released tracks and links to Spotify and to preview pages for listening. It sells nothing, takes no payments and does not prepare purchase or licensing requests.

publication.release_notes: Listening-only version: search, track lookup, similar tracks and playlist proposals with Spotify and preview links.
